newsitem.title: JAPAN: Sumitomo Bank reiterates support for Sumitomo Corp.
newsitem.headline: Sumitomo Bank reiterates support for Sumitomo Corp.

text.p: Sumitomo Bank remains ready to provide any financial support necessary to Sumitomo Corp despite the trade house's massive upward revision to its estimated loss from unauthorised copper trades, a bank spokeswoman said on Friday.
Both are members of the Sumitomo group and Sumitomo Bank is the so-called "main bank" for the trading house.
"Our stance is unchanged. We are going to give our full support to Sumitomo Corp despite the upward revision," the spokeswoman said.
Sumitomo Corp announced on Thursday it had raised to $2.6 billion from $1.8 billion its estimated loss from unauthorised deals by dismissed copper trader Yasuo Hamanaka.
Sumitomo Bank had pledged its full support to Sumitomo Corp when the giant trade house first announced its massive copper losses on June 13.
On July 24, Sumitomo Bank president Toshio Morikawa told a news conference that the bank had provided the trade house with modest additional loans.
